metadata.description: Get Canada Post rates for a package going from postal code M5S 2H7 in Canada to ZIP code 10001 in the United States

common_info.email_credentials: credentials to use the assigned disposable email account
common_info.user_info: alex_green_personal_info.json; the dummy user's personal information
common_info.user_resume: PDF resume with disposable email account injected

instruction: Open https://www.canadapost-postescanada.ca/cpc/en/tools/find-a-rate.page. Get Canada Post rates for a package going from postal code M5S 2H7 in Canada to ZIP code 10001 in the United States. It weighs 4.5 lb and measures 12 in long, 10 in wide and 8 in high. Enter it in pounds and inches or convert it correctly to metric. The outcome is the request for the list of rates; paying is not required.
